maria: Quick all-hands note — agenda for Wed 9:00am PT:
• 1) Exec update (15m)
• 2) Product launch callouts (20m)
• 3) Policy update: data retention defaults + support workflow (10m)
• 4) Q&A (15m)

Please drop any questions below or add them to the shared prep doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/all-hands-wed (edit access: @dalia, @samir). We’ll record and post the link afterwards. Hybrid: Room A + Zoom. Can ops confirm recording + captions?

ops-bot: Recording scheduled ✔︎
Zoom ID: 874-123-999
Captions: ON
Will upload recording + transcript to Drive after meeting.

samir: Can we squeeze a 5m slot for Dedicated pricing FAQ right after product?

maria: Good call, adding a 5m FAQ slot between product and policy.

dalia: Slide owners — please send final slides to me by Tues 5pm. I'll consolidate and run one slide-deck check Wed 8:30am PT.

jordan: AV note — I'll be on site at 8:15 to test mics and camera. Anyone doing live demo pls ping me so I can test screen sharing.

anya: Heads-up: a partner will be on the call; please redact their org-specific metrics (slide 3).

maria: Got it, we'll mask partner slides. Also, if any execs want a pre-brief, DM me and I'll schedule a 15m slot Tues.

---
(after meeting)

ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://drive.redwood/recordings/allhands-1794501110.mp4
Transcript: https://drive.redwood/transcripts/allhands-1794501110.txt

samir: TL;DR takeaways: 1) Exec: runway strong, hiring continues in infra 2) Launch date set: May 12 3) Policy change: hosted data retention default now 30 days (was 90), Dedicated & Private unaffected unless opted in 4) Action: Eng to confirm perf benchmarks for launch.

dalia: Slides (final) -> https://drive.redwood/slides/allhands-1794501110-deck.pdf
Action owners: @samir verify perf numbers by Fri; @jordan confirm demo script; @maria schedule follow-up sync with sales.

maria: Thanks everyone — great turnout :tada:. If you asked a question in prep doc and didn't see it covered, I'll follow up in threads by EOD.

ops-bot: Follow-up note: captions available on demand, retention policy change doc in /policies/retention-v2. Contact @security for compliance questions.
